mapper.select: SELECT `result` as `name`, count(1) as `openTotal` FROM (SELECT `device_id`, `result` FROM `group_control_log` where `result` = '成功' order by `create_time` desc) t GROUP BY `device_id`
select count(*) as `total`, sum(IF(cg.`action` = '开',1,0)) as `openTotal`, sum(IF(cg.`action` = '关',1,0)) as `closeTotal` from `group_control_log` cg

SELECT count(1) FROM `time_control_info` a inner join `time_control_details` b on a.`id` = b.`time_control_id` where `enabled` = true and a.`time_cycle` like concat('%', #{timeCycle}, '%') and (a.`plan_start_time` = NULL or `plan_end_time` > #{date})
SELECT count(1) FROM `time_control_info` where `time_cycle` like concat('%', #{timeCycle}, '%') and `enabled` = true and (`plan_start_time` = NULL or `plan_end_time` > #{date})
